bullets.content: [general] After EVERY solve call view(kind=error) and list the top-5 hotspots with local h BEFORE the next mesh. Never mesh in parallel with an unread solve. Skipped in g5: REPEAT risk. Self-estimate underrates true error: do not stop early.

[general] Never call compare(a,a). Before submit run compare() on two DIFFERENT solves (coarsest vs finest) and read stress_diff_energy_norm_rel plus regions. Confirm changes with view(error) hotspot shares, not energy alone. Skipped in g5.

[general] Use all 4 solves as single-factor points on one axis: s1 assigned value, s2 second value for slope, s3 best/combination. Rank by energy gain % vs 0.075 x DOF increase %, then e^2N. If the lever is flat, use s2 on a structural change. Ending after 2 solves wastes evidence. Last: compare, submit.

[general] If a refinement does not move delivered h in mesh() (group 'element size near' unchanged), do not solve it. Re-size to <=0.6x surrounding h or switch to a box. g5 wasted a solve on edge 40 with f2 h unchanged at 0.00385.

[general] Check the assigned lever is not already known flat before solving it; if notes say flat, use the solves on a new structural variant. If a note contradicts the plan, follow it or state the new evidence justifying a retest.

[general] Read min_quality before solving. Finer global h on a box recipe dropped quality 0.241 to 0.114. Reject min_quality <0.12 unless energy gain clears the pay line; break ties toward the higher-quality, cheaper mesh.

[general] Submit by estimated score (g/2)^2/c, c = DOFs/automesher DOFs. Compare to best known base (~0.244). If compare is within remeshing noise (~0.12 vs ~0.07) or the energy gain is tiny, submit the cheaper mesh. Refine only if ln(e_old/e_new)/ln(N_new/N_old) > 0.5.

[general] Below target the base is flat (e^2N 620-660), so bonuses decide rank. Keep one structural differentiator (e.g. h <0.008) when it costs <10% base: the +0.1 diversity bonus beat every base improvement in g5.
[general] Change exactly one factor per solve. If your own note contradicts the plan, follow it or state the new evidence; silent repeats are flagged.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Assigned variant: a0 frame at h 0.02 (diversity needs h >0.018, >1.5x peers' 0.012). Change nothing else.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Price h 0.02, 0.025, 0.03 with free mesh() calls first. Solve those whose nodes differ >=2% and min_quality >=0.12. Read hotspot local h after solve 1 (saddle f10/f12/f13/f20 z 0.022-0.025, clamp ring).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Global h finer is dead, proven three times: 0.012 to 0.0075 +0.03% energy for +5% DOFs; 0.0075 to 0.0065 +0.18% for +3.2% DOFs, quality 0.114 (0.241 at 0.0075). Never go below h 0.012; use h only for diversity (a8 h 0.03: 18.9%, points 9.5%); no h ladders.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Pay line for coarse h vs 6697-node/0.033436 J baseline: keep if energy loss % <= 0.05-0.075x DOF saving %. Diversity needs base >=0.221, e^2*N <=~697: at 19.5k DOFs field <=18.9% (estimate). Coarse h only costs shaft points, not the binding field term.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a0 (best base 0.246, 20091 DOFs, 17.7%): a14 frame plus edges 8/39 at 0.0024 r0.004 and wider flanks 0.0036: same accuracy as a14 (base 0.244, 20052 DOFs, 17.8%) with 1.1k fewer DOFs; extent beats flank size.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle cluster |x| 0.011-0.014, |y| 0.009-0.012, z 0.021-0.028 holds 11.6-16% at h 0.0039-0.0045; boxes deliver ~1.2-1.3x request. Keep flanks from |x| 0.010, zmin 0.021, |y|<=0.014. Test merged saddle box [-0.02,-0.014,0.019,0.02,0.014,0.032] 0.0028-0.003 r0.006 replacing both flanks.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle cells at z 0.0255 (|x| 0.006-0.017, |y| 0.013) hold ~3% each at h 0.0042-0.0047 with 110-200% local error; narrow flank boxes did not cut it.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Front/back saddle walls (x ±0.0058, |y|~0.013, z 0.0255) hold 13.2% at h 0.0047, outside flank boxes. Explorer idea: wall boxes [-0.012,0.009,0.02,0.012,0.018,0.035] plus y-mirror at 0.0032 r0.005.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Edge 40 {0.003 r0.005} is needed: without it clamp ring held 15.4% at z 0.0561. But edge 40 at 0.002 r0.006 added 277 nodes, f2 touching h stayed 0.00385, energy 0.033353->0.033326: edge refinement below ~0.0025 does nothing. Ring hotspot sits ~0.8 mm inside wall off f20.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring (four z 0.0561 cells) holds 14-15% in every recipe at h~0.0042; slow-converging. a5's clamp box [-0.017,-0.017,0.051,0.017,0.017,0.0575] 0.0032 cost +11% DOFs for +0.2% energy: fails pay line. Never f2 coarser than 0.0025. Ring box test only if paid by body box 0.0065.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring at z 0.0561 holds ~3.3% in each of four cells (hotspot #5 on f20, h 0.0040, 20% error). Low priority: box [-0.02,-0.017,0.050,0.02,0.017,0.0575] 0.003 r0.004 instead of f2/edge40 sizing, paid by body box 0.0065.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Cut DOFs: body box 0.0054->0.0065 with h 0.012 and a paid-for saddle box. Cost term 0.285 binds; aim ~15k DOFs at ~17.5% error.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Edge 39/8 radius is a dead lever: r0.008 vs r0.005 gave 15.8% vs 16.1% for +1077 DOFs; r0.0035 saved 2k DOFs (compare 0.12, noise). Saddle hotspots (±0.013,±0.010,0.024) stay at h 0.0043. Use a box, not radius.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Narrow flank boxes [0.012,-0.012,0.022,0.023,0.012,0.0345] 0.003 r0.004 gave energy 0.033479 vs 0.033492 for wide 0.0035 flanks at equal DOFs; f16 touching h stayed 0.00501. Keep wide flanks |y|<=0.016 from |x| 0.009.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Body box 0.0058->0.0048 at h 0.012: +13% DOFs (15.5k to 21.8k) for +0.9% energy, ~1.85x gain: break-even below target. Avoid; keep 0.0058 and spend DOFs on junction and clamp ring.

[abc_00000003_bc7] At h 0.012 min_quality was 0.196-0.255 (safe, not the limit). If a band box drops it below 0.12, raise radius to 0.006. Band size must stay <=0.6x body box (0.0035 limit); 0.0028 local sizes are affordable.
[abc_00000003_bc7] DOF guard: if mesh() returns >10500 nodes (~31.5k DOFs), r0.008 needs field error <=14.5% to beat a4's 0.221 base (estimate).
[abc_00000003_bc7] a4 (uniform h 0.0045, edges 39/8 0.002 r0.005, f2 0.0025): field 16.1%, check-point RMS 5.3%, 26.8k DOFs. Saddle hotspots lie ~0.0055 from edge 39, outside r0.005.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Error concentrates at boss/branch junctions f16/f19/f20/f18 (x=±0.019, y=±0.0075, z 0.025-0.03). Target the junction ring with edges 39/8 rather than whole faces.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Do not refine f16 as a whole group: it includes the boss shaft (black on error maps) and cost 495 touching elements. Refining f16/f19 at 0.003 plus band box at 0.0038 cost 22k DOFs for only 1.78x gain.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Hotspots #4-#6 on f20 near f16 junction (z 0.022-0.028) had 14-19% vM error at h~0.0043; worst hidden point near f20 x~0.017 z~0.0255. Refine f20 locally via junction box size 0.0033, not whole face (2500 elements).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Avoid uniform refinement: h 0.0065→0.0048 cost +55% DOFs for 1.62x gain; field error stayed ~19.7%. Coarser h 0.0055 saved 6.7k DOFs but changed field 15%: keep h only if the saddle box compensates.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Contested cells near f23 at x=±0.0173, y=-0.0128, z 0.005-0.015, and worst hidden point near f21: keep local h ≤0.0045-0.005 in lower body.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Peer a4 earlier (11.4k DOFs): h 0.007 plus f16 size 0.004 gave good accuracy per DOF. Combine coarse h with targeted junction refinement.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Peer a11 (17.5%) used edges 8/39 at 0.003 but hotspots stayed at f19/f16 (h~0.0049): edges need adequate radius (see r0.008 test) or box.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Diversity idea: order 2, h 0.014, body box 0.0065, stronger saddle and clamp box to cut cost; at 15k DOFs 17% error would beat last run. Alternative h 0.007 with f2 0.0025 and saddle box 0.003.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Field error (15.8-17.7%) binds over check-point error (4.8-9%). Rank by strain energy, e^2*N, compare() and hotspot shares near f20/f19 and clamp ring, not by points. P3 +14% not worth DOFs.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Energy-to-field calibration (g4, 8 runs): 0.03362 J->17.2%, 0.03342->17.7%, 0.03335->18.1-18.8%, 0.03317->18.7-18.9%. Estimate e from energy, rank by e²·N; beat 623 (a3) to lead base.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Cost term (0.305) is the limit: 19.9k DOFs vs 6.06k automesher. Need ~1.5x accuracy or DOFs ~13k. Prefer cutting DOFs (body box 0.0065) over adding them.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Setup verified: 3D, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f2, pressure f23 4e6, f16 2.1e6. Reuse verbatim; spend solves on mesh experiments. Net force noise on curved f23 is discretisation.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Assigned variant: a2's best recipe with ONLY the three bottom-box radii raised 0.003->0.006 (tier1 0.0018, tier2 0.003, wide box 0.0036). f7 r0.006, upper box r0.004, sizes, h 0.008 unchanged. Aim: grade clamp band into f9/f38 walls (h 0.0041, VM 7-9%).

[abc_00000065_bc0] Error is diffuse over the z=-0.006 layer near f5/f7 (cells x 0.015-0.025, y -0.011 to 0.014; 14.8%, 11.6%, 9.7% of energy) at h 0.0026; hotspots only 4-5% each. Tiers are near their limit; more refinement there is costly.
